sentences.text: All About Eve is a 1950 American drama film written and directed by Joseph L. Mankiewicz , and produced by Darryl F. Zanuck .	Joseph L. Mankiewicz	Joseph L. Mankiewicz	Darryl F. Zanuck	Darryl F. Zanuck	drama film	Drama (film and television)
It was based on the 1946 short story `` The Wisdom of Eve '' by Mary Orr , although screen credit was not given for it .	The Wisdom of Eve	The Wisdom of Eve	Mary Orr	Mary Orr
The film stars Bette Davis as Margo Channing , a highly regarded but aging Broadway star .	Bette Davis	Bette Davis	Broadway	Broadway theatre

Anne Baxter plays Eve Harrington , an ambitious young fan who insinuates herself into Channing 's life , ultimately threatening Channing 's career and her personal relationships .	Anne Baxter	Anne Baxter	fan	fan (aficionado)

George Sanders , Celeste Holm , Hugh Marlowe , Barbara Bates , Gary Merrill , and Thelma Ritter also appear , and the film provided one of Marilyn Monroe 's earliest important roles .	George Sanders	George Sanders	Celeste Holm	Celeste Holm	Hugh Marlowe	Hugh Marlowe	Barbara Bates	Barbara Bates	Gary Merrill	Gary Merrill	Thelma Ritter	Thelma Ritter	Marilyn Monroe	Marilyn Monroe

Praised by critics at the time of its release , All About Eve received 14 Academy Awards nominations -LRB- a feat only matched by the 1997 film Titanic and the 2016 film La La Land -RRB- and won six , including Best Picture .	Academy Awards	Academy Awards	Titanic	Titanic (1997 film)	La La Land	La La Land (film)	Best Picture	Academy Award for Best Picture

All About Eve is the only film in Oscar history to receive four female acting nominations -LRB- Davis and Baxter as Best Actress , Holm and Ritter as Best Supporting Actress -RRB- .	Oscar	Academy Award	Best Actress	Academy Award for Best Actress	Best Supporting Actress	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress
All About Eve was selected in 1990 for preservation in the United States National Film Registry and was among the first 50 films to be registered .	National Film Registry	National Film Registry
All About Eve appeared at # 16 on AFI 's 1998 list of the 100 best American films .	AFI	American Film Institute	100 best American films	AFI's 100 Years...100 Movies#List
